description.value: Ice Cream Mountain is a Kawartha Dairy retail outlet on the Trans-Canada Highway on the western edge of Victoria, BC, selling scoops and packaged products from this Ontario-based family dairy that has been crafting ice cream since the 1950s. As a dedicated branded retail store, it carries the full Kawartha lineup including flavoured ice creams and ice cream cakes. Its position on the Trans-Canada places it directly along the corridor cyclists use when travelling between Victoria and the western communities of the Capital Regional District.
